strategy.summary: Send the ball to the top until the base bonus is full and B-I-G is complete. Then complete B-E-N for Double Bonus. Resume top shots and collect the lit right saucer when its feed is safe.

quickInfo.name: B-I-G lanes
quickInfo.summary: Each top B-I-G lane advances the base bonus, and a completed set lights the right saucer for 5,000.

quickInfo.name: B-E-N drops
quickInfo.summary: Complete the three large B-E-N drop targets to enable Double Bonus for the current ball.

quickInfo.name: Right saucer
quickInfo.summary: The right saucer is worth 5,000 after one B-I-G completion, but a later completion can change it to Special.

quickInfo.name: Left rollovers
quickInfo.summary: The three rollovers on the left side score 1,000 each and add value during safe top play.

quickInfo.name: Skill shot
quickInfo.summary: Plunge through a missing B-I-G lane, because a weak plunge can fall through the open gap left of the lanes.

steps.text: Plunge through a B-I-G lane that is not complete.
Use both flippers to send the ball to the top. Build the base bonus to its maximum.
Continue top shots until B-I-G lights the right saucer for 5,000.
Test one B-E-N drop-target rebound. Complete B-E-N only while the returns remain controlled.
modeNotes: Double Bonus: Complete all three large B-E-N drop targets. The game then doubles the end-of-ball bonus.

steps.text: From the right flipper, resume the safer shot to the top.
From the left flipper, collect the lit right saucer only when the shot and kickout are safe.
Read the saucer lamp after another B-I-G completion. Do not shoot it when Special gives no tournament points.

fallback.title: Top play only
fallback.when: Use this when B-E-N rebounds or right-saucer misses threaten a drain.

steps.text: Send each controlled ball to the top.
Use B-I-G lanes and the left rollovers to build score and bonus.
Keep Double Bonus unqualified rather than risk a dangerous rebound.

alternatives.title: Lit right-saucer scoring
alternatives.when: Use this when the saucer shot and its kickout return cleanly to control.

steps.text: Complete B-I-G once to light the right saucer for 5,000.
Catch the ball on the left flipper when the feed permits it.
Return to top play after an unsafe miss or kickout.

buildsToward.title: Maximum base bonus at Double Bonus

steps.text: Use B-I-G lanes to reach the maximum base bonus.
Complete B-E-N for Double Bonus only after its rebounds prove safe.
Keep the ball in the top area after the doubled bonus is ready.
Collect the right saucer only while its 5,000 lamp remains lit.

techniques.name: Missing-letter plunge
techniques.instruction: Aim the plunge through a missing B-I-G lane. Use enough force to clear the open gap left of the lanes.

techniques.name: Flipper-based route choice
techniques.instruction: Use the right flipper for the top shot. Use the left flipper for the lit saucer only after its return is known.

cautions.issue: B-E-N drop-target rebounds can drain through the center.
cautions.response: Test one target before you commit to the bank. Use top play if the rebound is dangerous.

cautions.issue: A missed right-saucer shot can produce a dangerous return.
cautions.response: Shoot the saucer only from a controlled left flipper. Stop after one unsafe miss.

cautions.issue: A second B-I-G completion can replace the 5,000 saucer value with Special.
cautions.response: Read the lamp before each saucer shot. Ignore Special when the event gives it no point value.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Williams 1975 or licensed Segasa edition, ball count, replay and Special treatment, tilt, and maximum base bonus.
Read the right-saucer lamp after each B-I-G completion; confirm whether Special has tournament point value before collecting it.
Test B-E-N rebounds, the right-saucer kickout, top-lane registration, the open-gap plunge, and both routes back to the top.
strategy.simpleOverview: Big Ben uses B-I-G top lanes to build base bonus and light the right saucer for 5,000, while the B-E-N drops enable Double Bonus. Fill the base through top play, complete B-E-N only from safe angles, then protect the doubled bonus and take the saucer while 5,000 remains lit.
strategy.overview: Big Ben uses B-I-G top lanes to build base bonus and light the right saucer for 5,000, while the B-E-N drops enable Double Bonus. Maximize the base through the top, complete B-E-N only after its rebounds are proven, then return upstairs and preserve the doubled collect. Shoot the right saucer only while its 5,000 lamp is lit because a later B-I-G completion can change it to Special.
